body:
All six card sections now share one freely reorderable list and responsive reading column. Schedule and Labels can move between Description, Checklist, Counters and Comments. Existing browser preferences retain their prior reading order; mounted drafts, disclosure state, animation and reduced-motion behavior remain intact. Reordering causes no source write.

Verification: the full gate passed 251 Rust, 126 JavaScript and 12 Python tests. Eight Chromium and four WebKit suites passed, with layout checks from 320 to 1440px and landscape. The existing manual application was rebuilt and restarted; trusted HTTPS verified 33 build assets, all 31 prior resource versions, two pins, workspace preferences and certificate. Physical-device and release acceptance remain open.

Evidence: progress/2026-09-30-unified-card-sections.md.

metadata.summary: Unify all card sections into one customizable order
